predecessors.name: Makuria
predecessors.text: Lower Nubia, ruled from Gebel Adda and Qasr Ibrim after Dongola was lost in 1365

successors.name: Funj Sultanate
successors.text: the traditional view: 'conquered by the Funj Sultanate, founded in 1504' (Dotawo page)

successors.name: Ottoman Empire
successors.text: Lower Nubia, occupied by the Ottomans

ledger.x: 1415: the Makurian rump kingdom of Gebel Adda and Qasr Ibrim, as Cliopatria begins its 'Makuria Kingdom' row.
1504: the traditional end of the kingdom.

certainty.note: No frontier is described on either page except the 'first cataract' guess and the Aswan border lost for good in 1412/3.
